name: create-vite-react-ts
notes: What a new user starts from: create-vite 9.3.4's react-ts template (npm integrity sha512-L02vtfSVndf0I65g0axXCjrFbhyjmN5K7szeaLRd0mMx0duW2BpzNvps5q4zHHCWexOrWrPgAx17hRz88I3bHw==), with create-vite-overlay/ on top: Repos.tsx (lucide-react icons, one passed as a prop and rendered as a tag, useQuery, useMemo, a tags = [] default), Clock.tsx (useEffect with deps, with a cleanup, and on mount), Legacy.tsx (a render-only class with defaultProps, and a class with state and componentDidMount), main.tsx under a QueryClientProvider, and a package-lock.json that pins every version. commit is the hash of that tree, committed with a fixed author and date.

name: bulletproof-react
notes: The Vite + React Router app, and the form library: a widely copied reference architecture (React Router 7, TanStack Query, zustand for notifications, react-hook-form with zod, react-query-auth, Radix UI). 115 source files, yarn 1 lockfile. Its tsconfig sets baseUrl ".", which TypeScript 7 rejects (TS5102) before checking anything; without it, paths resolve from the tsconfig's directory, which is the same place.

name: shadcn-admin
notes: The context-heavy one: nine createContext providers (theme, font, direction, layout, search, and a provider per table feature), plus TanStack Router (with its committed routeTree.gen.ts), TanStack Query, zustand (auth store), react-hook-form, TanStack Table and shadcn/ui on Radix. 209 source files, pnpm lockfile.

name: react-admin-dashboard
notes: The zustand app on a component library with no Solid port: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, React Router 7, zustand stores for auth and settings, Ant Design 6 (its Form is the form library). 37 source files, npm lockfile.

name: shlink-web-client
notes: Redux: an actively maintained product (the Shlink URL shortener's web UI) on Redux Toolkit and react-redux, React Router, a dependency-injection container, and its own React component library (@shlinkio/shlink-web-component, no port). 58 source files, npm lockfile; the tsconfig covers its tests too.

name: t3code
notes: The large app the pass was developed on, and the one named in the release reports: apps/web of a pnpm monorepo (TanStack Router, TanStack Query, zustand, Effect atoms, @base-ui/react, lucide-react). At this commit apps/web/src has 1,383 source files, so it is far bigger than the other entries and dominates the run time. Earlier measured at this commit, with a full dev setup: React 0 type errors, 0.1.3's conversion 17,396. Here the React app has 71: installed with --ignore-scripts and not built, it lacks TanStack Router's generated route tree (not committed) and the NodeJS types in apps/web; they are subtracted per file. The workflow runs on 2 CPUs (with 6 workers it outgrew 3 GB and stalled); the type-check runs in chunks of 50 files.
